title: sorted-renders-the-cursor
intention: /sorted must RENDER a cast node's workflow string through cairn/tools/base/transitions.py render(), instead of hand-writing prose — and express the leaf fork as a cursor POSITION, never by deleting a skippable summons from the path.
why: Both code defects in the trouble are fixed and proven (fleet conformance 6/17 -> 13/17); this is the remaining half, and it is the half that REGENERATES the trouble. Until /sorted renders, the very next cast reintroduces it — which is the definition of an unclosed gate (Law 4). The class's vocabulary does not shrink per instance, so a path with a summons deleted is malformed, not skipped.
traces_to: Law 4 — enforced by physics: render() through transitions.py IS the physics
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured: the rendered string is the measurement of conformance

falsifier.proves_green: proof beside the code, sealed under the tester; a conformance re-scan of the fleet is the acceptance instrument
falsifier.proves_red: Cast a node through /sorted, then run the fleet conformance scan: if the newly cast node's string is not byte-identical to render()'s output, or if conformance falls below its pre-cast count, the gate did not close.
falsifier.horizon: at the next cast, every time — this one is checked by use

how: Make /sorted render the cast node's workflow string through cairn/tools/base/transitions.py render() instead of hand-writing prose. Express the result from the _conform conformance check in the string.
watchme: none, because acceptance is the fleet conformance scan itself, which is re-run and counted; a probe would restate the scan.
sorted_berth: none, because cast before the sorted door existed (ticket dated 2026-08-02, door landed 2026-08-03)
intent_berth: none, because this ticket entered at TICKET, not at INTENT — ruling 2026-08-02-three-entry-points-and-structural-refiled: a bug goes straight to TICKET. Its thinking artifact is the trouble record named in from_trouble, which carries the defect, the measurement and the fix-when-taken.
filed_edges: [AKIEN] BLOCKED ON THE SAME FORK AS ITS TROUBLE: writer-side rendering or door-side refusal. As cast, this ticket puts render() inside /sorted. Law 4 puts it in the chokepoint. If the door refuses unrendered strings, this ticket nearly vanishes and no future writer can reintroduce the trouble; if /sorted renders, the door stays permissive and the next writer that is not /sorted re-derives it. Answer once, in the trouble, and this ticket follows.

RETIRED IN PRINCIPLE 2026-08-05 by ruling 2026-08-05-gates-issue-clearances — /sorted stops writing a cursor at all, so there is nothing to render. Not closed by CC: retiring a cast node is a crossing, and the crossing is not CC's to make. Named here so no one builds it.
